note: Set P is one subject (nacreous pearl clouds) from four angles: rarity, an unseen observer, ephemerality, and surprise, though P1 and P4 share a winter-dusk frame. Set Q is three near-identical lenticular-over-ridge poems (Q1, Q3, Q4 all use midwinter, wind, lens, ridge), with only Q2 (dusk veil, shell sheen) offering a different take.
